Counsel for the petitioner after arguing the matter for some time submits that the petition may be dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to the petitioner to file a fresh petition after examination of the victim girl is completed before the Trial Court.
2. The aforesaid submission is placed on record.
Petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as prayed for.
Considering the period of incarceration of the NC: 2024:KHC:45760 petitioner, the Trial Court and prosecution shall make endeavors to examine the victim girl/C.W-1 on priority before the Trial Court.
